remarks:
Welcome to 5079 Woodland Drive, in the most desirable neighborhood Lewiston has to offer, Lewiston Heights! Stunning almost 5,000 sq ft stucco home offering 4 bedrooms, 4 full baths, 2 half baths, private yard, porch and a patio, a heated 3 bay garage and a finished basement. Lives like a ranch with a bedroom and an en-suite, laundry, and two offices all on the first floor. Thoughtfully updated while preserving its original charm, this home features refinished hardwood floors, gorgeous trim and crown molding throughout, all new carpet, fresh paint throughout, and all new lighting. Enjoy the convenience of a brand new roof, newly painted stucco and updated mechanics.

Walk in through the impressive foyer, through the kitchen which offers, a new double oven, built-in JennAir range, and generous space for everyday living and entertaining. The great room and front living room each have their own gas fireplaces and are both so spacious. First floor bedroom en-suite/guest bed, an office/den, a library/2nd office, and more storage than you can imagine. Upstairs, the primary bedroom has its own gas fireplace, 2 walk-in closets, a large dressing room/3rd closet, an en-suite with a double sink vanity, a Japanese soaking tub, a glass shower, and a water closet. The other two bedrooms upstairs  each have en suites and walk-in closets, too. Outside you have a front porch as well as a back patio and a private, greenery filled yard.

Major updates include a brand-new roof, new furnace and AC, multiple hot water tanks, sump pumps and radon mitigation systems, refinished hardwood, new carpet, whole house painted in and out, and concrete touches. A spacious, character-filled home with major updates already completed. All that’s left to do is move right in.
